That night he climbed the spiral stairs earlier than usual, polished the lens until it gleamed, and watched the beam sweep across the dark water, steady as a promise.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有醒来。街灯在空荡的马路上投下昏黄的光，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，轮胎压过潮湿的路面，留下一阵轻响。高楼的窗户大多暗着，只有零星几盏灯亮着，像未眠的眼睛。早点铺的老板已经开始揉面，蒸笼里冒出第一缕白气。环卫工人推着车，扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。风从街角吹来，带着一点凉意。远处的天边仍是深蓝，城市在寂静中等待黎明。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine Russian nesting dolls: you open one doll and find a smaller doll inside, and you keep opening until you reach the tiniest doll.\n- The tiniest doll is the stopping point, and without it you would keep opening dolls forever."}
